resources.string: B or Y: back to the app. Trigger: play or pause. A, X or grip: show or hide this panel. Right thumbstick left or right: turn the view, hold it to keep turning. Left thumbstick left or right: previous or next media. Up or down: 10 seconds forward or back in a video, turn a photo by 90 degrees.
